newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 70 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had raised the minimum permitted rate for one-week refinancing funds by five percentage points, to 70 percent.
BNR said it also slashed refinancing funds on offer to 750 billion lei from last week's 1.1 trillion.
The BNR's tightened monetary policy aims at calming quickening inflation, and is in line with International Monetary Fund recommendations.
Year-on-year inflation surged to 56.9 percent last December, triple the 20 percent target agreed with the International Monetary Fund for 1996.

The BNR and Romania's new centrist ruling coalition are holding new talks with the Fund over renewed credits, which were suspended last year following foreign exchange market curbs and overspending in an electoral year.
